objective: Review the generator and test changes of commit b5d21e1 on release/0.2.1/feat/design-skills (worktree /home/user/holyagent-feat-design-skills): the shared-core embedding and the design-skill tests.
scope: Read /home/user/holyagent-work/spec-0.2.1.md Part C binding requirement 7 and deliverable 4.
Review 'git -C /home/user/holyagent-feat-design-skills show b5d21e1 -- packages/integrations/claude/src packages/integrations/claude/tests packages/runtime/tests' and run those tests there.

Check withDesignCore and the marker handling, whether the tests fail without the change and actually catch a stale core or a banned term (try a mutation), duplication with the existing frontendDesign or shared-file embedding patterns (B1), and Windows path behavior.

Each finding: file:line, evidence, blocking or not, smallest fix. Report in under 400 words.

criteria.text: The embedding is correct and the tests fail on a stale core or a banned term
No duplicated generator logic is introduced

result:
result: Embedding is correct and the tests catch a stale core, a missing core and a banned term; no blockers.

changed: none (mutations ran on a `git archive` copy in the scratchpad).

checks:
- `bunx --no-install mise run verify` in `/home/user/holyagent-feat-design-skills` -> exit 0. Type-check clean on 131 files, lint clean on 132, format clean on 259, tests 1075 pass / 1 skip / 0 fail.
- `/code-review medium b5d21e1^...b5d21e1` ran; the built-in loaded. I triaged its 10 findings below.
- Mutations on the archive copy, running `design-skills.test.ts` (run in the archive copy with `bun test`, not `mise`):
  - Generator drops the core, or leaves the marker unreplaced: 2 tests fail.
  - `tui-design` removed from `DESIGN_SKILLS`: 1 fails.
  - "React" appended to `web-design/SKILL.md`, "Tailwind" appended to `core.md`, or `Next.js`/`SwiftUI-based` appended to `core.md`: the framework-name test fails.
  - `### Spend boldness in one place` repeated in a skill source: 1 fails.
  - CRLF in a skill source: `generate()` throws "must hold the line … exactly once".
  - Core edited without a rebuild: `plugin.test.ts` "every committed generated file equals a fresh build" fails. `design-skills.test.ts` does not catch this on its own, because it compares in-memory output against the same file.

blockers: none

findings (all optional):
1. `generate.ts:189-205`: the marker is enforced only for names in the hand-kept `DESIGN_SKILLS`. A new design skill left out of the list would ship a literal `<!-- design-core -->` line with no error. The smallest fix is to embed the core wherever the marker line appears, or fail the build if a `SKILL.md` outside the list holds the marker.
2. `design-skills.test.ts:40-76`: the banned-term check is case-sensitive, so lowercase `react` passes. Capitalised ordinary words (`Compose`, `Textual`, `Blessed`, `Qt`) would fail on plain prose. This is acceptable because the check is documented as whole-word and case-sensitive.
3. Windows: `.gitattributes` forces `eol=lf`, so the CRLF failure above is unlikely. `listFiles` already returns POSIX paths (`toPosix`), so the `split("/")` and `endsWith("skills/<n>/SKILL.md")` lookups work. The tests build paths with `join(ROOT, …)`.

Code-review findings I rejected:
- Bare `Error`, `async` and `Promise.all` in `generate.ts`: `bundle()` and the rest of the file already do this, and lint passes. The Effect rule is for runtime and CLI source.
- The 80-140 line test: Part C deliverable 1 asks for about that range, so the test follows the spec.
- Attribution license wording, `(default)` markers, macOS text scale and Windows title-bar content: these are skill content, not the generator or tests I was asked to review.
- Missing root integration (`visual-judging`, `root/skills.md`, role references): this is Part C deliverable 2, outside this commit's scope. The root should confirm a later commit covers it.

Duplication (non-blocking criterion): `withDesignCore` is a marker-line swap, and `frontendDesign` in `agents.ts:503` is a different job (heading shift on a vendored file). They share no logic. Spec requirement 7 is met: one source file, embedded per skill, and a test that checks the core in every skill. Not run: a real Windows run.

evidence:
The embedding is correct and the tests fail on a stale core or a banned term: mise verify exit 0 (1075 pass). The mutation runs above all fail as expected. A stale `dist` is caught by `plugin.test.ts`, and generator or core omission is caught by `design-skills.test.ts`.
No duplicated generator logic is introduced: `generate.ts:189-205` is a distinct marker mechanism, separate from `agents.ts:503` `frontendDesign`.

findings: items 1-3 above, all optional, no blockers.
